creative_rules: Use original characters and worlds; do not imitate copyrighted characters or studios.
Keep humour kind, age-appropriate, and easy to understand for ages 5-8.
Avoid frightening imagery, dangerous imitation, bullying, humiliation, and misleading educational claims.
Use clear English dialogue, expressive character acting, and a positive resolution.
Do not use copyrighted songs, characters, logos, or unlicensed sound effects.
